chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 608 - A Horrifying Face From the Past Shakes Li Huowang's World
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang defeats the Doumu Heart-Pan, triggering a True-False Heavenly Way shift. But when he confronts the mastermind, Xu Shou, a single face from an old nunnery changes everything.
og_title: The Siming Falls, But a Familiar Face from Anci Nunnery Rises
og_description: After a brutal Intercalation of the Five Phases, Li Huowang wins the fight. But as he pulls off Xu Shou's sunglasses, he sees the face of Abbess Jingxin's Heart-Element son—and reality begins to crumble again.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian 608: Victory turns to dread as Li Huowang recognizes a face he thought was locked in Anci Nunnery.
twitter_description: The Heavenly Calamity ends. The mastermind falls. Then his sunglasses come off. And Li Huowang realizes the horror was never just in one world.

lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden technique from the Thousand Greats Record that sacrifices the five viscera to Bashe for overwhelming power. It corrupts the Daoist Five Phases system into a weapon of self-mutilation.

One of the fundamental laws of the universe. A Siming who masters it controls the oscillation between reality and unreality. The Heavenly Calamity is the world's symptom of a Siming struggle over this Way.
A mortal whose very existence acts as a causal anchor for a Siming. Killing a Heart-Pan can deprive a Siming of their foothold in reality, forcing a direct confrontation.
The name of the Dao-Twisted World within the novel. To “send someone to the Great Qi” is a euphemism for killing them by severing their connection to the world.
